description: De-identified eight-track in-vivo adult healthy-volunteer cardiac ultrasound acquisition. Each track contains 100 frames from an attempted parasternal long-axis view acquired with a Philips S5-1 phased-array probe on a Verasonics Vantage 256. Tracks were acquired in fixed order with fixed receive gain and TGC while keeping the untracked probe as steady as possible; the volunteer was instructed to breathe out before each track. The operator had no prior ultrasound training or acquisition experience. Direct identifiers, acquisition dates/times, source filenames, local paths, and private linkage information are not included.

description: Robotically tracked freehand ultrasound of a Blue Phantom Gen II PICC, PIV and Arterial Line Vascular Access training model (BPA304-HP), an upper-extremity arm phantom with a nine-vessel system (cephalic, basilic, medial cubital, radial and ulnar veins plus brachial, radial and ulnar arteries) embedded in self-healing tissue-mimicking material. Verasonics Vantage NXT with an L11-5gH linear probe (128 elements, 0.30 mm pitch, 7.6 MHz) held by a KUKA LBR robot. Each frame is a 7-angle plane-wave acquisition (-18 to +18 deg), 21 walking 64-element mux acquisitions per frame, raw pre-beamformed channel data with the measured end-effector pose attached per frame. Seven tracked sweeps over the same phantom are concatenated, with respective out-of-plane angles [-15, -10, -5, 0, 5, 10, 15] degrees .
